instruction: Change Chrome's startup pages to 'google.com' and 'github.com', instead of 'funbrain.com'.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y
cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"session":{"restore_on_startup":4, "startup_urls":["http://funbrain.com/"]}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: This task requires updating Chrome's startup URLs list from ['http://funbrain.com/'] to ['http://google.com/', 'http://github.com/']. The setup configures Chrome with funbrain.com as the startup URL. The custom getter extracts the list of startup URLs from Chrome preferences, and the custom metric compares the current list against the expected list using set comparison (order-independent).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts Chrome startup URLs from preferences file (session.startup_urls)
Metric correctly handles type='rule' by directly accessing expected.get('urls') since get_rule() returns the rules dictionary
Set comparison logic appropriately handles order-independent URL matching
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement (update startup URLs list)
Edge cases handled: empty lists and None values properly converted to empty sets
No postconfig needed: getter reads from persistent Chrome preferences file
